newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toa Steel shares down in Tokyo on weak earnings.
newsitem.headline: Toa Steel shares down in Tokyo on weak earnings.

text.p: Shares in Toa Steel Co Ltd fell in early Tokyo trade on Monday after the firm's weak earnings announcement last week, brokers said.
As of 0059 GMT, shares were down 17 yen at 268, making the company the biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Turnover was 40,000 shares.

On Friday, the steelmaker, which is affiliated with NKK Corp, reported a parent current loss of 17.21 billion yen for the year which ended on March 31, up sharply from the previous year's 6.27 billion yen loss.
The firm forecast a parent current loss of eight billion yen for the current business year.
